text: Coffee with Kemal. His knee op is Thursday at 8am and his wife Dana is driving him in. He's pretty nervous about the anaesthetic. Text him the next day to see how it went. Dana's also stressed because her work is doing a big audit that same week, so she's juggling both. Might offer to do the pickup on Friday afternoon if she's stuck.

Long lunch with Sinead and Rin. Rin's new manager is micromanaging everyone and she's thinking of leaving. Sinead's 40th is on the 14th, she's mad into bouldering at the moment so a climbing voucher would go down well. Rin's got an interview elsewhere on Wednesday at half 1, which she hasn't told work about. We said we'd all go for drinks the Friday after, whatever happens.

Ivan rang. His dad's back in hospital with pneumonia, been there since Sunday. Ivan's flying to Riga tomorrow morning and staying till at least the weekend. His sister Krisztina is already out there. He asked if I could cover his Thursday meeting with the Garcia people at 2pm. Must check in with him on Monday, and send over notes from the meeting that evening.

Caught up with Jess after work. Her client pitch with the Novak account is Friday at 3pm and she's been rehearsing all week. Her boss Gareth wants her to lead it. Then she's off to Lisbon the week after for her friend Ximena's hen do. Gareth also mentioned the client is notoriously picky, they sacked the last agency after one meeting. Jess says she's fine but she was biting her nails the whole time.
Haruto's birthday is next Saturday. He's into vinyl and Japanese whisky. Sophie says he's already got loads of whisky so maybe a record.
Emre had his gallbladder out on Tuesday. Home now, sore but fine. His partner Michael is taking the week off to look after him. Pop round with soup at the weekend.
Dinner at Suzanne's was cancelled, her youngest has chickenpox. Rescheduling for sometime in November.
Dentist the 12th at half 9. Car MOT the day before. Must sort the insurance renewal afterwards too.
Quick chat with Delroy at the school gate. He's started at the council planning office, loving it apparently. His daughter Amy starts swimming lessons on Wednesday.

Gintaras (Gin to everyone at work) is leaving at the end of the month for a job at a fintech in Vilnius. Leaving drinks are on the 28th at 6. Need to chip in for the card and present, Eilidh is collecting.

Met Ximena for a walk. Her mum's hip replacement went well last week and she's already up on crutches. Ximena's exhausted from the hospital runs though. Her brother Eduardo is finally coming over from Madrid on Sunday to help. Her mum's physio starts the day after he arrives and the follow-up with the surgeon is a week after that, on the 11th at 10am. Ximena's also got a big deadline at work, so she's barely sleeping.
Krisztina's anniversary with Lars is on the 3rd, ten years. They're doing a weekend in the Lake District. She wants to surprise him with a proper camera, he keeps borrowing hers.
Kenji's annual review is tomorrow afternoon. He's worried his manager will bring up the missed deadline in August. Text him good luck that morning.
Ming called. Her scan results came back clear! She sounded so relieved.
Siobhan is having her wisdom teeth out on Friday morning. Her flatmate Jess is picking her up afterwards. Siobhan's vegan so no ice cream from the usual place, get the oat one.
Stefan's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday and is in a cone for two weeks. Stefan's working from home the whole time to keep an eye on him.
Gabriel's new at the office, joined the data team on Monday. Moved from Lyon with his girlfriend. Big cyclist, does the Ride London every year. Invite him to Thursday lunch.
Sunil Kumar from the Bristol client called. They want to push the quarterly review to the 22nd at 10am. He'll send the revised deck the day before. Let Karan know.
Rang Mum. Uncle Javier is going in for a heart bypass on the 9th. Everyone's a bit on edge. She's going up to stay with Aunt Suzanne the week after to help out.
Emil and Sophie are expecting! Due in April. Sophie's had awful morning sickness so they kept it quiet until now. Emil is already reading every baby book going.
Need to buy a birthday present for Ryan by Wednesday. He mentioned wanting a new pair of trail running shoes, size 10. Maybe ask his sister Amy which brand.

Grabbed a drink with Michael and Karan. Michael's been made team lead, starts officially on the 1st. Karan is applying for his old role and the interview's next Tuesday at 2. Karan's not confident at all, keeps saying he's not ready. I should send Michael a congrats card and check in with Karan on Monday evening before the interview.
Gareth's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is a week on Friday at 11. He's taking compassionate leave till then.
Need to pick up Dana's prescription Thursday after work, pharmacy closes at 6.
Gym, groceries, call the plumber.
Eilidh's physio after the ACL op is twice a week now, Mondays and Thursdays at 7am. She can walk without the brace but no running till spring. She's frustrated, misses netball.
Rin's birthday dinner is Saturday at 8 at the Korean place. Her boyfriend Kemal organised it. She's obsessed with Studio Ghibli, maybe the Totoro art book.
Lars got the promotion! Head of engineering from January. His wife Krisztina said they're celebrating at the weekend. Don't forget to send him a message.
Caught Javier in the corridor. The Garcia contract finally signed. His boss Delroy is taking the team out for dinner next Friday evening to celebrate.

Haruto's mum fell and broke her wrist on Sunday. Surgery to pin it was yesterday. He's driving to Leeds every weekend now to help. He seems really stretched, work's piling up too. Ring him Thursday night. His manager Kemal has been decent about it and given him Fridays off for now, but Haruto said the team are grumbling. His birthday is the 30th too, not that he'll want a fuss this year.

Sinead mentioned Ivan's 50th is coming up on the 17th. Surprise party at the cricket club, 7pm. He's into gardening and real ale. I'm doing the playlist. Sinead's collecting money for a joint present, she's thinking a fancy greenhouse heater. His wife Dana is keeping him busy that afternoon with a fake garden centre trip. Don't mention anything to Ivan when I see him Thursday.
Ryan's colonoscopy is Wednesday at 10. Nothing serious they think, just checking. He has to fast the day before and his partner Siobhan is taking him. Message him that evening to see how it went.
Long call with Dana. Her new client is a nightmare, emails at midnight. She's thinking about freelancing again next year. Her son starts at Stirling uni in September.
Emre and Michael's housewarming is the 25th from 4pm. They've just moved to Walthamstow. Bring a plant, Emre loves anything trailing.
Kemal's knee op got postponed again, now the 30th at 7:30am. He's fed up. Text him the night before.
Mrs Evans from next door is home from hospital after her stroke. Her daughter Ming is staying with her for a fortnight. Drop round some flowers tomorrow afternoon.
Sophie said Jess's interview at the BBC went really well, second round is Monday at 11. Jess is a bag of nerves about the presentation part.
Stefan is retiring at Christmas after 32 years at the firm. Retirement do is the 19th. Get him something for his fishing, he's always on about a new reel.
Karan's wedding is in Goa in February. Invites coming next month. He and his fiancée Ximena are doing a small registry thing here first, on the 6th.
Siobhan's in hospital with appendicitis, emergency op last night. Recovering ok. Her mum's flying in from Cork tomorrow. Call her at the weekend once she's home.
Emil's leaving drinks were called off, half the team are off sick. He finishes Friday anyway and starts at Zhou & Partners the Monday after.
Gabriel Bianchi from procurement asked for the updated pricing by Thursday at noon. Ask Sunil to double check the figures the day before.

Talked to Amy for ages. She's training for the Edinburgh half in May, first ever race. Her husband Delroy thinks she's mad. Also she's gone gluten free, coeliac diagnosis last month. Remember that for the dinner on the 15th. She's also stressed about work, the new head of sales is cutting her team. She said Delroy's mum is visiting from Kingston that week too.
Michael's sister Suzanne had a baby girl on Tuesday morning! Seven pounds two. Mum and baby both home.
Lunch with Krisztina. Her daughter's grade 5 piano exam is Saturday at 9:15 and she's practising every night. Krisztina's more nervous than the kid.

Ivan said the new MD is restructuring the whole department. Redundancy consultations start next week and his one-to-one is Wednesday at 4. He's trying to stay positive but obviously worried. I need to check in with him afterwards. He also mentioned his wife Rin got into the Open University counselling course, starts in February, so congratulate her when I see her.
Gareth's fiftieth is a week on Saturday. His wife said he's been dropping hints about a Garmin watch.
Javier Fernández (JF on Slack) is covering my clients while I'm away from the 2nd to the 9th. Brief him Friday morning before I go.
Eduardo's cataract op is Monday. His daughter Ximena says he can't drive for a fortnight afterwards. I'm taking him to the follow-up appointment the week after.
Haruto got into the choir he auditioned for! Rehearsals every Tuesday. So pleased for him.
Note to self: book flu jab for next week, Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon ideally.

Kenji's partner Ming is a nurse on the cardiac ward, just went onto nights. Kenji's been doing all the school runs. Their son is seven, mad about dinosaurs, birthday on the 8th. Maybe the Natural History Museum dinosaur kit.

Dana's hysterectomy is booked for the 4th, then six weeks off. She's anxious about it, mainly the recovery. Her sister Eilidh is moving in for the first fortnight. Remind me to send something nice the day after and to offer to walk her dog Rolo.
Team meeting ran late. Lars thinks Gintaras is getting the client lead on the Evans project. Sinead isn't happy about it, she's been on that account for two years.
Sunil's wife had her hip done last Tuesday. He's been working half days to look after her. Seems ok but tired.
Coffee with Emre. He and Michael are off to Japan for three weeks in March, Tokyo then Kyoto. Emre's learning Japanese on Duolingo. Michael hates flying so he's dreading the 14 hours.

Kemal's knee op finally happened this morning at 7:30. Dana says it went fine and he's groggy but eating. Message him tomorrow afternoon to see how he's doing. Maybe take round the crossword books on Saturday, he's into cryptics.
Amy's son Ryan passed his driving test today, first time! She's thrilled. He's saving for a car.

Phone call with Jess, Siobhan and Rin to plan Sophie's birthday. It's on the 21st but we're doing brunch the Sunday before at 11. Sophie's into pottery and houseplants. Jess suggested a wheel throwing class voucher. I'm booking the table.
Quiet day, nothing much. Finished the report.
